manifest.title: HK Utilities & Infrastructure Sector Monitor
manifest.description: CLP quarterly electricity sales by customer sector, CenStatD town gas consumption, HKO temperature, Power Assets geographic segment reporting, DSD sewage flow/laboratory data and WSD water-suspension notices.

cards.description: Quarterly electricity sales in GWh and AI Data-Centre growth.
Monthly town gas consumption in Terajoules (TJ).
Daily mean temperature and monthly average (°C).
Power Assets semi-annual geographic segment revenue and profit (HK$ million).
Current WSD planned and emergency water-suspension event feed.

charts.title: CLP Electricity Sales by Sector (GWh)
charts.subtitle: Quarterly sales across Residential, Commercial, Infrastructure & Public Services, and Manufacturing.

charts.title: Hong Kong Town Gas Consumption Trend (TJ)
charts.subtitle: Monthly gas consumption split by Domestic, Commercial, and Industrial user types; latest ten years of available history by default.

charts.title: Hong Kong Observatory Monthly Mean Temperature (°C)
charts.subtitle: Monthly average of HKO daily mean temperatures; latest ten years of available history by default. Daily source observations remain at source cadence outside this compact public chart.

charts.title: Reported Sewage Flow across Treatment Works (Monthly Sum)
charts.subtitle: Monthly sum of daily final-effluent flow reported by the treatment works available in each month; the source remains daily and coverage changes over time. Per-works history remains in the dataset.

tables.title: Power Assets Geographic Segment Breakdown
tables.subtitle: Semi-annual segment reporting (2025 H1), HK$ million. 'Investment in HKEI' is equity-accounted and reports nil consolidated revenue/segment profit under this note; its contribution appears in the JV/associate results column instead.

tables.title: Latest Sewage Treatment Works Flow and Laboratory Observations
tables.subtitle: Latest available row for each treatment works. Core lab fields are shown; additional source-sparse lab fields remain in the dataset and are not imputed.

tables.title: Current Water Suspension Notices
tables.subtitle: Current WSD planned/emergency notices, including scheduled future notices. Start/status fields are shown; source address and cause fields remain in the dataset. This is an event snapshot, not a water-consumption time series.

sources.label: CLP Power Hong Kong Electricity Sales Disclosures

query.description: Quarterly electricity sales in GWh broken down by customer sector (Residential, Commercial, Infrastructure & Public Services, Manufacturing) plus AI Data-Centre demand growth.
Monthly town gas consumption in Terajoules (TJ) by user type (Domestic, Commercial, Industrial) — de facto Towngas monopoly operational proxy.

sources.label: Hong Kong Observatory Daily Mean Temperature

query.description: Daily mean temperature (°C) and monthly averages — primary physical weather driver for air-conditioning power load.

sources.label: Power Assets Holdings Geographic Segment Reporting

query.description: Semi-annual geographic segment reporting note (revenue, segment profit, share of JV/associate results) broken out by Investment in HKEI, United Kingdom, Australia, and Others.

sources.label: DSD Daily Sewage Flow and Effluent Laboratory Data

query.engine: official DSD CSV catalogued by CSDI
query.description: Daily final-effluent flow and sparse laboratory observations (BOD, TSS, nitrogen, oil/grease, pH and E. coli) by sewage treatment works; treatment-works coverage changes over time.

query.engine: official WSD event feed catalogued by CSDI
query.description: Current planned and emergency water-suspension notices with district, affected address, start/resumption time, cause and current status; refreshed every five minutes and not a continuous consumption series.
